stem.text: An object is thrown into the air.
Which graph shows how the gravitational potential energy $E_\text{p}$ of the object varies with height $h$ above the ground?

A.alt: Graph with E_p on the vertical axis and h on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line rising from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with E_p on the vertical axis and h on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line falling from the E_p axis to the h axis.

C.alt: Graph with E_p on the vertical axis and h on the horizontal axis, showing a curve that rises from the origin to a peak and falls back to the h axis.

D.alt: Graph with E_p on the vertical axis and h on the horizontal axis, showing a curve that falls from the E_p axis to a minimum and then rises.
